source.title: Northern Herald, 21 January 1933, p. 3 ("The municipal elections: changes in Belfast and Newtownards")
source.publisher: Northern Herald (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: two candidates for one seat; Baxter's 450 and Brett's 286 read on the page image

note: Annual thirds, polled 16 January 1933, one councillor retiring in each of the five wards (Castle, Central, Glen, Scrabo, Victoria). Four wards were uncontested; the only contest was in Scrabo Ward, where Isaac Baxter defeated the retiring member T. A. Brett. Baxter was an ex-councillor who had been unsuccessful at the previous election. The paper notes that the Newtownards Baxter and a Councillor Isaac Baxter in Bangor were unrelated.
